field.label: Enable UniFi Gateway
field.help: Run the UniFi gateway emulator daemon. The device appears in the UniFi controller as a UGW3 (USG-3P) gateway.

field.label: Controller hostname
field.help: Hostname or IP of the UniFi controller used for inform/enroll, e.g. unifi.example.com. The daemon informs http://<host>:<port>/inform. If the controller sits behind a vhosting load balancer, use the exact address its inform listener answers on — the bare IP when in doubt (a wrong vhost answers informs with HTTP 400).

field.label: Controller inform port
field.help: Inform port on the controller. Default: 8080.

field.label: Device hostname
field.help: Hostname the emulated gateway reports to the controller. Leave empty to use this firewall's hostname.

field.label: WAN interface
field.help: Real interface mapped to the emulated WAN port (eth0), e.g. vtnet0 or igb0. Its counters become the controller's WAN statistics.

field.label: LAN interface
field.help: Real interface mapped to the emulated LAN port (eth1), e.g. vtnet1 or igb1. LAN IP/MAC are derived from it unless overridden.

field.label: LAN IP override
field.help: IPv4 address reported as the emulated gateway's LAN address. Leave empty to use the LAN interface's primary address.

field.label: Reported firmware
field.help: Firmware version reported to the controller. Pin to a version the controller treats as current to avoid upgrade nagging. Default: 4.4.57.5578372.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Daemon logging verbosity. Routine inform cycles log at Debug.
